tasks.title: Reject whitespace-only login credentials
tasks.description: Users can submit a login form with spaces in the email or password. Reject blank and non-string credentials while preserving valid logins.

events.message: Reproduced the bug: 3 of 6 regression checks fail.
Preparing the lab’s documented repair plan.
Prepared a patch for 1 file. Repository originals remain intact.
Checking the proposed change against available validation.
Your proposal is ready. Review the diff, evidence, and validation before accepting.

plan: Check that both credentials are strings.
Reject credentials that become empty after trimming.
Preserve the existing error shape and valid-login behavior.

evidence.text: The truthiness check accepts non-empty strings containing only spaces.
